name: GitHub MCP Server (local stdio)
description: Self-run packaging of github/github-mcp-server (OCI image ghcr.io/github/github-mcp-server or Go binary) over stdio. v1 workaround split from mcp_server.github-remote. Supports --read-only and toolset selection.

provenance.notes: Registry packages[0]: registryType oci, identifier ghcr.io/github/github-mcp-server:2.0.2, transport stdio, optional GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN (secret); omit it to log in with OAuth on first use. Supports version, transport. trust_level is a t4c research suggestion, not a security approval: trusted_external = maintained by the vendor whose API it fronts or by a named organisation, with publisher identity checked against the official MCP Registry namespace or the vendor's own docs; it does not make returned content trusted (see note, #35).

README: local server via Docker or 'github-mcp-server stdio'; browser OAuth login with token kept in memory only, or PAT via GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN (takes precedence); --read-only mode; GitHub App auth for non-interactive stdio. Supports auth_methods. auth_methods records the credential types the server accepts from the client or its environment: oauth2 = MCP authorization (OAuth 2.1) or an upstream OAuth login; api_key = a static bearer/personal/agent token passed by header or environment variable.
